files.armchair.md:
Reproduction mid-century lounge armchair, tan leather

Price: $640
Dimensions: 84cm wide, 80cm deep

A comfortable reproduction of a well-known mid-century design, bought new in 2021. It has tan leather and a walnut veneer shell, and it has lived in a smoke-free study.

There is a small scratch on the right arm, visible in the photos. The rest of the leather is in good order and the swivel is smooth.

Pickup from Balmain. It is a ground floor pickup, so there are no stairs to carry it down.
